newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Minister sees Russia-De Beers compromise.
newsitem.headline: Minister sees Russia-De Beers compromise.

text.p: Finance Minister Alexander Livshits said on Saturday that Russia and South African diamond giant De Beers had found a compromise in talks on Russian diamond sales, but Interfax news agency gave no details of a possible deal.
"Nobody is beating anybody," Interfax quoted Livshits as saying after the Moscow talks. "A compromise has been found which represents the interests of both Russia and De Beers."

The talks, also attended by representatives from Russia's monopoly diamond producer Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS), centred on about a dozen amendments the Russian government wants to make to a deal reached between ARS and De Beers last September.
De Beers stopped all purchases of diamonds from Russia on December 31, 1996, cancelling the interim arrangement after Russia failed to approve or reject a new trade deal.
Livshits said on Tuesday that Russia still wanted a gem export deal with De Beers.
